content: वर्ण् €10 <ab>U.</ab> (वर्णयति-ते, वर्णित) .²1 To colour, paint, dye; यथा हि भरता वर्णैर्वर्णयन्त्यात्मनस्तनुम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 To describe, relate, explain, write, depict, delineate, illustrate; वर्णितं जयदेवेन हरेरिदं प्रणतेन <ls>Gīt. 3</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 18</ls>. .²3 To praise; extol. .²4 To spread, extend. .²5 To illuminate. .²6 To exert oneself. .²7 To send, cast. .²8 To pound, grind.
